10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:499f8f92-1f9f-47.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) professional eager to shape how artificial intelligence understands and applies identity management? Join 10x Team as a Freelance IAM Consultant – AI Trainer and use your expertise to enhance next-generation AI models, all while enjoying the flexibility of remote, project-based work. About Us: 10x Team connects top independent professionals with leading AI labs to accelerate progress in artificial intelligence. We are looking for knowledgeable IAM experts based in the EU or UK to help train AI systems in identity governance, access control, regulatory compliance, and IAM best practices. Key Responsibilities: - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to identity governance, access provisioning, and authentication frameworks - Assess the accuracy and practicality of AI-driven recommendations on access management, role-based access control, and compliance - Develop real-world case studies and scenarios from your IAM experience - Create scenario variations covering identity lifecycle management, regulatory requirements, and risk mitigation - Identify and explain gaps or risks in AI recommendations, providing structured, actionable feedback - Influence how AI systems interpret IAM best practices and security standards About You: - Experienced IAM consultant with a solid background in identity and access management - Based in the EU or UK - In-depth understanding of access control models, authentication, identity governance, and regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, SOX) - Analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to deliver structured feedback - Available 8–20 hours per week and comfortable working remotely and asynchronously Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance roles – 100% remote - Directly shape how AI systems support digital identity and access management - Access ongoing professional development through the 10x Team AI Academy - Supportive community of independent experts, clear briefings, and streamlined onboarding How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Step into the future of AI-powered identity and access management – apply today! #LI-TT1 ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Company Summary FL130 (Flagship Labs 130) is an early-stage biotechnology startup aiming to answer an ambitious and exciting question: What if… we could systematically identify bioactive peptides to inspire next-generation therapies and uncover novel targets? To answer this question, FL130 is pioneering a novel approach to peptide screening, and is recruiting a team of top-tier scientists to help build it. This is a unique opportunity to be one of the first employees of a biotech startup that combines an innovative mindset with the resources and know-how of Flagship Pioneering. FL130 is backed by Flagship Pioneering, a company that invents and builds platform companies, each with the potential for multiple products that transform human health, sustainability and beyond. Since 2000, Flagship has originated and fostered the development of more than 100 scientific ventures advancing human health and sustainability, including Moderna, Generate Biomedicines, and Alltrna. Position Summary We are seeking a motivated and highly collaborative Principal Scientist to design, stand up and run high-throughput pooled screening campaigns. The successful candidate will have a strong track record designing large libraries for high-throughput screening as well as running pooled, FACS-based screens, from library production and transduction through selection, sequencing, and analysis (including culturing and screening in primary and primary-like cell lines). This role is among the first hires, affording the exciting opportunity to shape and influence the company’s scientific direction. This is a hands-on role with substantial ownership for a scientist who is excited to set technical direction from day one and, over time, help build the team. Key Responsibilities Plan, execute, and analyze high-throughput pooled screens using FACS as the primary selection modality, owning the full experimental cycle end to end. Design and build custom DNA and oligo libraries for high-throughput pooled screening, including barcoding strategies that link genotype to construct. Develop and optimize FACS-based selection strategies (gating logic, sort schemes, multi-parameter panels) across a range of cell lines, including primary-like and difficult-to-transduce lines. Culture and screen in primary and primary-like cell models, adapting workflows to maintain viability and library representation. Produce, transduce, and functionally titer lentiviral libraries; optimize MOI, coverage, and representation. Prepare sorted populations for next-generation sequencing; build and run genomic / amplicon sequencing preparation and barcode-readout workflows to deconvolve which library members are enriched or depleted. Analyze sequencing data to call hits (enrichment statistics, controls, and reproducibility). Optimize existing workflows and establish best experimental and documentation practices to enable platform excellence and rapid, accurate data turnaround. Partner with protein-engineering and translational colleagues to close the loop between library design, screen design, and downstream validation. Translate data into insights and present at team meetings. Must-have Qualifications PhD. in molecular or cell biology, genetics, bioengineering, or a similar field with 10+ years of industry or postdoctoral experience (level commensurate with experience). Extensive hands-on experience running high-throughput pooled screens with FACS-based selection, owning planning, execution, and analysis end to end. Proficiency designing DNA and oligo libraries for high-throughput screening, with a strong grasp of library design considerations (diversity, coverage, barcoding, and synthesis constraints). Strong flow cytometry and cell-sorting expertise, including panel design considerations, operation troubleshooting and maintenance of cell sorters. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. As Profound's first Recruiting Operations Manager hire, you'll own both the infrastructure and the team that powers how we hire at scale. You'll build and lead a team of Recruiting Coordinators, architect the systems and processes that let every recruiter move faster, and bring genuine AI and automation expertise to bear: not as a buzzword, but as a forcing function for doing more with less. This is a rare opportunity to define what modern recruiting operations looks like at a company building at the frontier of AI. WHAT YOU'LL DO Lead & develop the Recruiting Coordination team - Hire, manage, and grow a team of Recruiting Coordinators as our hiring volume scales, owning their day-to-day priorities, development, and performance - Build the team structure, capacity model, and operating rhythms that allow the function to keep pace with aggressive hiring targets - Set clear expectations and accountability frameworks so the team executes consistently without bottlenecks Own and evolve the recruiting tech stack - Own Profound's ATS end to end: pipeline configuration, stage definitions, scorecards, automations, and integrations with scheduling and sourcing tools - Manage the full recruiting technology ecosystem beyond the ATS, including scheduling tools, sourcing platforms, and LinkedIn Recruiter, ensuring we extract full value from each - Identify, evaluate, and implement AI tools that meaningfully reduce manual work across the recruiting lifecycle, from sourcing and scheduling to candidate comms and debrief collection - Build AI-enabled workflows and automations that increase coordinator throughput and recruiter efficiency without sacrificing candidate experience Build the data foundation for smart hiring decisions - Design and maintain a recruiting metrics dashboard tracking time to hire, pipeline conversion by stage, source quality, offer acceptance rates, and capacity utilization - Audit the full hiring process across every function, diagnose where candidates stall and where we lose people we shouldn't, and fix it - Partner with Finance and People Ops on headcount planning and req tracking to ensure approved hiring plans move through the pipeline on schedule Enable hiring managers to be force multipliers - Design and run hiring manager enablement programs including structured intake templates, interview guides, and calibrated scorecards that make hiring managers faster and more consistent - Set SLAs across the recruiting process and hold all parties accountable to them - Build documentation and playbooks that codify how we hire, from role kickoff to debrief to offer close, so the function scales without degrading - Own interviewer training across the company, building a program that gets every new Profound employee ramped on structured interviewing, bias awareness, and consistent evaluation before they step into a loop WHO YOU ARE - Experienced operator and people manager with 6+ years in recruiting operations, HR systems, or a closely adjacent function, including 2+ years managing a team - AI-forward: you've actively experimented with and deployed AI tools in a recruiting or operational context, and you think in term

strategicgrowthpartners-strategic-growth.description: SGP Recruiting provides both operations and strategic support to Tribal 8(a) and commercial organizations. Our client is a family of SBA-certified Native American Tribal 8(a) and multi-certified companies delivering IT, management consulting, and general construction solutions to the Federal Government and commercial sector. They are actively seeking a Junior Server Administrator. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of our client's dynamic team supporting a Team Awareness Kit Interagency program. Clearance: Public Trust background investigation is required for this position. Workplace Type: This position will be staffed as full-time equivalent (FTE). Work will be completed on-site at a government facility in Washington DC. Compensation: $60,000 - $75,000 per year The main responsibilities of the role include: - Maintain Server installation and operating system updates; Track, manage and sustain Platform Server modifications, updates, modifications, patches; Provide Server and/or Platform support for customers. - Identify, propose, manage, install, configure, sustain and support third party (integrated) application required to support the platform. Tactical Awareness Kit Interagency Operability USSS - Standard Sensitive Info. - Manage and maintain all patches to ensure Security Compliance Provide technical support for application, appliance, device support and/or troubleshooting of the platform, third party applications associated to the platform and end user devices/appliances. - Coordinate with, and support Application Development teams working within the USSS for updates required for platform functionality. - Coordinate with and support Mobile Device Management teams withing within the USSS needed for platform, application and/or end user appliances. - Support installations, diagnosis, updates and sustainment of enterprise workstations. • Support the development of system administration policy, requirements and daily maintenance procedures and support activities. - Support the creation of maintenance plans, operational procedures, how to guidance, program documentation used by support technicians, users, help desk etc. - Support the integrate platform servers in small team and mission planning systems upon request by agency program managers. - Provide recommendations and support efforts to coordinate capability enhancements developed by the Department of Defense to receive operational approvals, certifications, and internal agency approvals needed for implementation. - Document newly identified mission cap based on emerging technology improvements/enhances and submit to agency program managers for review and potential integration to the current platform. Qualifications: - Expertise Level: Junior - Experience: 1 year IT Server Administration experience. - Experience Needed: Azure Cloud computing, Linux Environments (Red Hat / CentOS), Windows Environments, VMware Environments, Network Security, Mobile Applications (iOS / Android), Mobile Device Management, Integrated and tactical Radio Networks, Geospatial / Mapping caching servers. thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Are you a Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) ready to grow your career in a thriving, patient-focused practice? MidLantic Urology (MLU) is seeking a full-time Advanced Practice Provider to join the team in Pottstown, PA ! As a member of Urology Alliance (UA), MidLantic Urology (MLU) is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven. physician-led urology network. This partnership empowers MLU to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging Urology Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our providers can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. Position Highlights: Join a well-established, physician-led urology practice with 4 experienced urologists and 2 APPs. Collaborative environment where APPs are valued as integral members of the care team and work alongside all physicians. Broad clinical scope treating patients with BPH, kidney stones, UTIs, incontinence, prostate cancer follow-up, and other general urologic conditions. Perform a variety of office-based procedures, including catheter changes, s/p tube exchanges, injections, and urodynamic studies. Balanced practice with a mix of outpatient clinic and inpatient hospital rounding at two local hospitals. Supportive, collegial culture with long-tenured providers and staff. Community Overview – Pottstown, PA: Pottstown, PA offers the perfect blend of small-town charm and convenient access to the greater Philadelphia region. Located along the scenic Schuylkill River, the community features a vibrant downtown with local restaurants, breweries, boutique shopping, and year-round community events. Outdoor enthusiasts enjoy easy access to parks, hiking and biking trails, and recreational opportunities at nearby French Creek State Park and the Schuylkill River Trail. Residents benefit from a lower cost of living than many surrounding Philadelphia suburbs while remaining within commuting distance of Philadelphia, Reading, and King of Prussia. With excellent schools, a welcoming community, and a growing local economy, Pottstown is an ideal place to build both a rewarding career and an exceptional quality of life. Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Sp

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:1edc0c2d-58b.title: Slovak SEO Specialist
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:1edc0c2d-58b.description: About Adapt Adapt, a Welo Global brand, is an international digital performance marketing agency focused on driving the success of digital content across platforms and markets. We offer our customers a unique combination of global services designed to support their growth from strategy all the way through to execution, production, and performance measurement. With a collaborative and inclusive environment, you will join a unique culture which celebrates difference and embraces diversity. You will play a key role in developing strong relationships and shared ethos, whilst at the same time benefiting from a wide range of career opportunities, training, and flexibility for work-life balance. Our culture is built on curiosity, and we are looking for team members who have a passion for learning about the developments in the industry, their clients, and their peers. In return, we offer the opportunity to develop your ability and exposure to a wide range of clients from growth-minded startups all the way up to global enterprise clients. Our client base is predominantly focused on B2B businesses, though we do also support customers in the e-commerce and retail space. Regardless of vertical, Adapt offers dynamic and diverse challenges that foster creativity, innovation and application of knowledge to create client solutions. MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB We are seeking a freelance SEO Specialist to join and support our SEO team. In this role, you will play a key part in enhancing our SEO efforts by conducting keyword research, utilizing keyword planners, and optimizing content, among other responsibilities. MAIN DUTIES The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership for this role: - Keyword Research - Keyword Planner - Metadata Optimisation - Content Optimisation - On-Page Optimisation - Keyword Translation from English to Slovak and Slovak to English - Data Handling and Management - SEO Copywriting REQUIREMENTS Education Level Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from a college or university in a related field, or equivalent work experience. Experience A minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in SEO. Strong working knowledge of HTML and JavaScript for SEO, with basic skills in writing and reading code. In-depth understanding of best practices for various search engines, including Google, Bing, Baidu, and others. Proven ability to deliver successful results through SEO initiatives. Extensive knowledge and experience with analytics tools such as Google Analytics, SiteCatalyst, and WebTrends. Advanced proficiency in Excel for data analysis and reporting. Expertise in using third-party SEO analysis tools, including Screaming Frog, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Majestic, and similar platforms. Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to set priorities and meet deadlines consistently. Strong understanding of how other online and offline marketing channels—such as display ads, affiliates, social media, print, TV, and email—interact with and influence SEO. Please note that successful candidates will need to have an Office 365 License installed into their devices to be able to complete the tasks assigned.
